items.name: Default
items.template:
<nve-pagination value="1" items="100" step="10"></nve-pagination>
<script type="module">
  const pagination = document.querySelector("nve-pagination");
  pagination.addEventListener("change", (e) => console.log(e.target.value));
</script>
items.summary: Basic pagination component with default styling and behavior.

items.name: Skippable
items.summary: Pagination with skip buttons to navigate to first and last pages quickly.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Disabled pagination component that prevents user interaction.

items.name: Flat
items.summary: Pagination with flat container styling for a more minimal appearance.

items.name: Inline
items.summary: Inline pagination layout that fits inline with content.

items.name: DisableStep
items.summary: Inline pagination with disabled step selector to prevent page size changes.

items.name: Forms
items.template: submit page 10
items.summary: Pagination as a form associated component that participates in form submission and emits change, input, and step-change events. Use when page selection needs to integrate with form data collection or server-side form handling.

items.name: NoItemsCount
items.summary: Pagination without items count display, useful when total count is unknown.

items.name: LargeValues
items.summary: Pagination handling large datasets with higher step values for efficient navigation.

items.name: DynamicItems
items.template:
<nve-pagination disable-step container="inline" value="1" items="100" step="20"></nve-pagination>

<script type="module">
  const pagination = document.querySelector("nve-pagination");
  let items = loadItems();

  pagination.addEventListener("last-page", async () => {
    items = [...items, ...loadItems()];
    pagination.items = items.length;
  });

  function loadItems() {
    return new Array(100).fill("");
  }
</script>
items.summary: If the upper bound of items is unknown, use the `last-page` event to determine when to load more data and update the pagination with the latest total of items.

items.name: DynamicStepSize
items.template:
<!-- javascript property binding -->
<nve-pagination value="1" items="10000" step="100" step-sizes="[100, 500, 1000]"></nve-pagination>
items.summary: When a custom step exists, the select options dynamically adapt to the step and append to the default option list.

items.name: SuffixLabel
items.summary: Use the `suffix-label` slot to customize the "of total" label when dealing with approximated totals from API responses. This is useful when the API returns a limited count but indicates there are more items available.

items.name: PageListPattern
items.template:
<nve-toolbar container="inset">
  <nve-button disabled container="flat"><nve-icon name="chevron" direction="left" size="sm"></nve-icon> previous</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat" selected>1</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat">2</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat">3</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat">4</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat">next <nve-icon name="chevron" direction="right" size="sm"></nve-icon></nve-button>
</nve-toolbar>
items.summary: Custom pagination pattern using toolbar with numbered page buttons and navigation arrows.

items.name: SkipPattern
items.template:
<nve-toolbar container="inset">
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="arrow-stop" direction="left" aria-label="first" disabled></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="chevron" direction="left" aria-label="previous"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-button container="flat" selected>1</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat">2</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat">3</nve-button>
  <nve-button container="flat">4</nve-button>
  <nve-icon-button icon-name="chevron" direction="right" aria-label="next"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button icon-name="arrow-stop" direction="right" aria-label="last"></nve-icon-button>
</nve-toolbar>
items.summary: Enhanced pagination pattern with first/last page buttons and numbered page navigation.

items.name: VerticalPattern
items.template:
<nve-toolbar container="inset">
  <label nve-text="body muted sm">1 of 13</label>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" size="sm" icon-name="chevron" direction="up" aria-label="previous"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" size="sm" icon-name="chevron" direction="down" aria-label="next"></nve-icon-button>
</nve-toolbar>
items.summary: Vertical pagination pattern with up/down navigation arrows for compact layouts.

items.name: CustomSelectPattern
items.template:
<nve-toolbar container="inset">
  <nve-select style="--width: 80px">
    <select aria-label="page size">
      <option value="10">1-10</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <label nve-text="label muted sm" style="width: 40px">of ~13</label>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="chevron" direction="left" aria-label="previous" disabled></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="chevron" direction="right" aria-label="next"></nve-icon-button>
</nve-toolbar>
items.summary: Custom pagination with select dropdown for page size and navigation arrows.
